name: AFFIN
recent: AFFIN Bank 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利按年下滑约 22% 至 RM113.57mil，主要受较高减值拨备与营运开销影响。分析员指出，赚幅压力可能使公司无法达成 FY2026 目标，并提及资产质量与资本压力。此外，多名高管在 8 月至 10 月期间于场外减持股份。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利 RM113.57mil，按年下滑约 22%。
多名高级管理人员（包括集团社区银行主管、集团人力资源主管、集团内部审计师及集团合规主管）于场外减持股份。
董事局及提名与薪酬委员会、审计委员会出现人事变动，包括 Dato' Abdul Aziz Bin Abu Bakar 的董事局变动。
risks: 季度净利按年下滑约 22%，主要因减值拨备与营运开销增加。
分析员指出公司面临赚幅压力、资产质量及资本压力，可能无法达成 FY2026 目标。
多名高级管理人员在 8 月至 10 月期间于场外减持股份。
earnings: 最新一季（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止）净利为 RM113.57mil，按年下滑约 22%，主要受较高减值拨备与营运开销影响。上一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收为 RM647.39mil，按季微跌 0.9%，净利为 RM127.52mil，按季下滑 5.9%，净赚幅为 19.7%。

recent_en: AFFIN Bank announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026, with net profit down about 22% year-on-year to RM113.57mil, mainly due to higher impairment allowances and operating expenses. Analysts noted margin pressure may cause the company to fall short of its FY2026 targets, and flagged asset quality and capital pressures. Several senior officers also disposed of shares outside closed periods between August and October.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit of RM113.57mil, down about 22% year-on-year.

Several senior officers (including Group Chief Community Banking Officer, Group Chief People Officer, Group Chief Internal Auditor and Group Chief Compliance Officer) disposed of shares outside closed periods.
Changes in the boardroom and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Audit Committee, including a boardroom change for Dato' Abdul Aziz Bin Abu Bakar.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell about 22% year-on-year, mainly due to higher impairment allowances and operating expenses.
Analysts noted margin pressure, asset quality and capital pressures, and the company may fall short of its FY2026 targets.
Several senior officers disposed of shares outside closed periods between August and October.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (ended 30 September 2026) net profit was RM113.57mil, down about 22% year-on-year, mainly due to higher impairment allowances and operating expenses. The previous quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue was RM647.39mil, down 0.9% quarter-on-quarter, with net profit of RM127.52mil, down 5.9% quarter-on-quarter, and net margin of 19.7%.
